en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Al Qasim, from Al Husayn Bin Abu Al A’ala, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

and he<sup>asws</sup> struck his<sup>asws</sup> hand to a cushion in the house, (then said): ‘A cushion, the Angels having had leaned upon it for long and sometimes we<sup>asws</sup> tend to find their fluff (from their wings)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Muhammad ibn al-Qasim from al-Husayn ibn abu al-‘Ala’ who has said the following.

“Once Abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) said, ‘O Husayn, tapping his hand on a cushion in the house, saying, ‘Cushions on which for a long time angels have been leaning and perhaps we pick up some of their fluff around.”
